<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **13** documentable anchor(s).

**34** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 95734fef75e6abfe2ab68a5ffa588e9b4a387392`.

⛔ **9** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **183** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 95734fef75e6abfe2ab68a5ffa588e9b4a387392` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `d5cd32d68b439d723fa4796753f1581c76705d88` — the merge of head `fce607bb2c6f1c56b153f24fe36617126ffa29f7` into base `95734fef75e6abfe2ab68a5ffa588e9b4a387392`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin d5cd32d68b439d723fa4796753f1581c76705d88 && git checkout d5cd32d68b439d723fa4796753f1581c76705d88
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 95734fef75e6abfe2ab68a5ffa588e9b4a387392 fce607bb2c6f1c56b153f24fe36617126ffa29f7 && git checkout -B drift-repro 95734fef75e6abfe2ab68a5ffa588e9b4a387392 && git merge --no-ff fce607bb2c6f1c56b153f24fe36617126ffa29f7

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 95734fef75e6abfe2ab68a5ffa588e9b4a387392
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 95734fef75e6abfe2ab68a5ffa588e9b4a387392` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4d99d24e61cd15d4a7989bcaa457df3d626a0405`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/export.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/system/validation-message.ts + packages/core/src/utils/import-runner.ts, packages/core/src/utils/import-runner-duplicate-match-key-36980.test.ts, packages/core/src/utils/import-runner-multi-value-match-key.test.ts, content/docs/references/api/export.mdx, content/docs/data-modeling/import-mappings.mdx, .changeset/37025-import-blank-multi-value-key-language.md

### ① Derived judgments

- **Catalog keys (`validation-message.ts`).** `BUILTIN_VALIDATION_MESSAGES` is exported as an open string-keyed record of string-keyed records (locale, then message key) and `RenderValidationMessageInput.messageKey` is `string`. No Zod enum, no literal union and no `api-surface/system.json` row enumerates the keys; the export list is unchanged (`BUILTIN_VALIDATION_MESSAGES (const)` only). Two rows of data are added in each of `en`, `zh-CN`, `ja-JP`, `es-ES`. Nothing a parser accepts or refuses moves, so no accept-set widens.
- **Override names.** `validation.field.import_blank_match_key` and `validation.field.import_multi_value_match_key` become names the renderer asks the i18n service for. `translation.messages` is an open string record, so a bundle carrying them parsed before and parses now; the change is that the name is read. Same class as #37009's `import_duplicate_match_key`, declared `no` / `none` there. `Clause-②: no` holds; `yes (widening)` would be wrong.
- **`matchFields` `.describe()` (`export.zod.ts`).** Prose only; the schema shape, the `string[] | string[][]` type and every refusal code are unchanged. `export.mdx` moves by the same two lines in both tables.
- **Row text.** `ImportRowResult.error` changes for two rows; `code` (`BLANK_MATCH_KEY`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`), `action`, `ok`, `row` and the multi-value row's `field` (first offending API name) are unchanged, read at `import-runner.ts` ~1600 and ~1648. The door's `400 INVALID_REQUEST` still returns `multiValueMatchKeyRefusal(...).message` (`rest/import-prepare.ts` ~723), untouched by the diff.
- **Does a REST caller's refusal text change?** Yes, one: a `POST /data/:object/import` caller sending ordered key sets now reads `The row has no match key: every key set (Email; Phone + Company) has a blank field on it` where it read `... every key set in matchFields (email; phone + company) ...`, in English too. That is human text, not contract: ADR-0114 puts the machine vocabulary on `code`, and no non-test reader in the repo or `ui/` matches either old sentence (grep at head: `has no match key`, `no one value to compare`). Not a clause-② event.
- **Reach, checked.** `BLANK_MATCH_KEY` as a failed row needs `isMatchKeySets(matchFields)` (`blankKeyIsRowError`, ~882); the wizard's `assembleImportRequest` sends a flat set and `isMatchKeyField` (~645) keeps list and structured fields out of the picker; a mapping's `upsertKey` is flattened to strings at `import-prepare.ts` ~594. The PR's narrower reach statement holds.

### ② Semver level

- `@objectstack/spec` patch, `@objectstack/core` patch: correct for `Metadata-protocol: none` on a non-protocol text change. No other released package moves (`rest`, `plugin-grid` untouched).
- `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are line-initial and identical in the PR body and the changeset. `Check Changeset` and `PR-body guards` are green on the head.
- No BREAKING banner is owed: nothing an author can write is removed, renamed or tightened.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions: []` — nothing to answer.
- Deviation "first WIP push before overlap-check": overlap-check read clean before every later push; no path collision on `origin/main` (27 first-parent commits since the merge base, none touching the seven changed source and doc files; `git merge-tree` is clean).
- Deviation "spec and rest suites narrowed locally, left to CI": answered by the head's check-runs — `Test Core` 10/10 shards and the aggregate are success.
- Out-of-scope item (a), the stale "same refusal" clause in docs and describe: closed in this PR's fix round, see S1 for what the replacement now says.
- Out-of-scope item (b), request-level English sentences in `import-prepare.ts` and `connector-pull.ts` `refuseBlankMatchKeys`: accepted as outside the card, but it is "noted, not filed" with `carrier: none`; see S2 for the row sentence the list misses.
- `security_findings: withheld` carries no content on the thread, so it cannot be answered here. Read independently: the diff adds no read, write or permission path; a label is interpolated once as a value (`interpolateValidationMessage` is single-pass, and the override template is fetched without params), so a label spelling `{{rows}}` prints as written.
- SQL push-down: no new id materialisation, query or in-app join. The multi-value path returns before any row is read.
- Check-runs on the head: 74, of which 62 success and 12 skipped, none failed or pending.

### ④ Design judgment

Held against the code:

- **Language from the request:** yes. Both helpers pass `{ locale: coerceCtx.locale, translate: coerceCtx.translate }`, and `coerceCtx.locale` is `context?.locale` (~1065), the same pair `duplicateMatchKeyMessage` and `import-coerce.ts` use. `resolveBundleLocale` handles `zh`, case and variants; absent locale falls to `en`.
- **Label over name:** yes. One shared `fieldLabel = metaMap.get(f)?.label?.trim() || f`; a whitespace-only label falls back to the API name. On the REST door the metaMap labels are already overwritten with the locale-translated ones (`import-prepare.ts` ~499), so the label is in the request language there.
- **Four languages:** present under all four locale keys; terms match the sibling entry (`匹配键`, `一致キー`, `clave de coincidencia`); ASCII punctuation in zh-CN is the table's existing style. Each template carries `{{label}}` and no other placeholder, which is all the runner supplies.
- **Mechanism reuse:** the card's "reuses #37009's mechanism" holds; no second rendering path. The wizard renders `error` verbatim, so no wizard change is owed.

Findings:

S1 (should-fix) — The rewritten `matchFields` `.describe()` (`export.zod.ts` ~319), both regenerated `export.mdx` rows, `import-mappings.mdx` ~307 and the changeset say the multi-value row's `error` is "in the request language" and (changeset) that a deployment can override it. The only callers that can receive this row are the two pulls, and neither hands the runner what those claims need: `connector-pull.ts` ~912 and `datasource-pull.ts` ~376 pass no `translate`, so `validation.field.import_multi_value_match_key` is never consulted there, and they forward whatever `context` the pull was started with (`{ isSystem: true }` by default in the connector pull), which the PR body itself says carries no request locale ("run without a request locale and so read English"). The published text therefore promises a language and an override that the row's only readers do not get at this head. Either word it as what is true (the catalog sentence, by label, in the caller's locale when the caller carries one, English otherwise; override reachable only where the caller passes a translator) or scope the override sentence in the changeset to the blank-key row.

S2 (should-fix) — The PR body calls these "the import runner's two remaining English row refusals". A third stands on the same code path, eight lines above the blank-key site: `AMBIGUOUS_MATCH` at `import-runner.ts` ~1642 is still `matchFields matched more than one ${objectName} record`, an English sentence naming the API parameter and the object's API name. Unlike the two fixed here it is reachable from the wizard (one flat key set, `update` or `upsert`, two records sharing the key). It is outside card #37025 and is not owed in this diff, but the claim of closure is false and the dev report's out-of-scope list does not carry it: correct the sentence and give the row a carrier.

N1 (nit) — Neither helper passes `field` to `renderValidationMessage`, so `{{field}}`, which the module's Interpolation section offers to templates, stays literal in an override of these keys, and with several offending fields only the first API name survives (on the row's `field`). The row's actual reader is a mapping author editing `upsertKey` in API names; the door's sentence gave name and type. Same gap as the #37009 sibling.

N2 (nit) — `fieldLabel` was inserted between `duplicateMatchKeyMessage`'s docblock and the function (~1075-1082), so that docblock now documents `fieldLabel`.

N3 (nit) — The `en` and `es-ES` `import_multi_value_match_key` entries end with a full stop; the `zh-CN` and `ja-JP` ones and every sibling `import_*` entry do not. zh-CN `匹配键逐个字段比较一个值` reads stiffly beside `每个字段只比较一个值`.

N4 (nit) — Test strength: `toMatch(/\p{Script=Han}/u)` is satisfied by the label alone and proves nothing the `toBe` above it does not; no case covers a deployment override of either new key, two offending fields joined with `, `, or ja-JP / es-ES through the runner (the catalog completeness test covers presence only). The recorded ablation covers the blank-key site; the multi-value site is held by the flipped pin's `not.toBe(door message)`.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-37025-import-row-refusals-language`
Reviewed-by: `fresh subagent of session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 席位核对 — REWORK · L1 · head `4d99d24e61cd15d4a7989bcaa457df3d626a0405` · 2026-11-24T23:29Z

Requested by zone a4-U for card #37025. Beside the contract review at this head (CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER, schema face): PASS with two should-fix — both are this round's REWORK.

Holds: the two catalog keys render through #37009's mechanism with the field label; codes, row shape and the REST 400 are unchanged; the catalog is an open string-keyed record with no enum, union or api-surface row listing keys, so `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, patch are right; the narrower reach in the PR body is true in code (the wizard cannot trigger these two refusals). Check-runs: 62 success, 12 expected skip, 0 failed.

S1 (should-fix) — the `matchFields` `.describe()`, the regenerated `export.mdx`, `import-mappings.mdx` ~307 and the changeset say the multi-value row reads "in the request language" and can be overridden; its only callers (connector and datasource pulls) pass no `translate` and no request locale, so at this head that row reads English with no override. Say what is true for each caller path (REST with a request locale vs a direct runner pull), in all four places.
S2 (should-fix) — the PR body's "two remaining English row refusals" is not the whole set: `AMBIGUOUS_MATCH` (`import-runner.ts` ~1642) is still English, names `matchFields` and the object API name, and is reachable from the wizard. Correct the body and file a follow-up card for it (the zone files it; same mechanism, area:ux).

Nits: pass `{{field}}` where the catalog sentence takes it; the orphaned docblock on `fieldLabel`; the full-stop inconsistency across the four locales; strengthen the Han-regex assertion to the exact sentence; one override test.

Asked of the zone: the dev report's `security_findings: withheld` has no carrier on the thread — tell the seat (privately, not on GitHub) what it refers to, or correct it to `none`.

Landing K: 27 — merge `main` in this round. Delta contract review and delta L1 on the new head.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `b3b32a888c9ac768c590932aff7bcaccbc71e94f`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/export.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/system/validation-message.ts + packages/core/src/utils/import-runner.ts, packages/core/src/utils/import-runner-duplicate-match-key-36980.test.ts, packages/core/src/utils/import-runner-multi-value-match-key.test.ts, content/docs/references/api/export.mdx, content/docs/data-modeling/import-mappings.mdx, .changeset/37025-import-blank-multi-value-key-language.md

Delta review of `4d99d24e61cd..b3b32a888c9a`, after the record at `4d99d24e` (PASS, S1, S2, N1 to N4) and the seat's REWORK (comment 7147480857). The delta is one merge of `main` and two commits.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The merge (`a9dcc7504e7`).** Parents `4d99d24e61cd` and `355c73c7ede0`. Its tree is `4b7ce9f05dd8`, byte-equal to `git merge-tree --write-tree` of the two parents: a clean mechanical merge, no hand resolution to read. None of the `main` commits it brings touches a file of this PR or a caller it depends on (`import-runner.ts`, `validation-message.ts`, `export.zod.ts`, `export.mdx`, `import-mappings.mdx`, `connector-pull.ts`, `datasource-pull.ts`, `data-action-routes.ts`).
- **Non-merge delta (`a9dcc750..b3b32a88`), 7 files, +60/-20.** In `packages/spec/src/**`: one `.describe()` sentence in `api/export.zod.ts`, one docblock paragraph and three catalog strings (`en`, `zh-CN`, `es-ES` of `import_multi_value_match_key`) in `system/validation-message.ts`. No Zod shape, export, enum, error code or `api-surface` row moves; the catalog stays an open string-keyed record and gains or loses no key in this delta.
- **Accept-set.** Unchanged. Nothing a parser accepts or refuses moves between the two heads. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` still hold, line-initial and identical in the PR body and the changeset.
- **`{{field}}` now supplied (N1).** `blankMatchKeyMessage`, `multiValueMatchKeyMessage` and the older `duplicateMatchKeyMessage` pass API names as `field`. `renderValidationMessage` adds `field` to the interpolation params only; the override key is still `validation.field.<messageKey>`, so no lookup name changes. No built-in template carries `{{field}}`, so every built-in sentence renders as before. The one observable change: a deployment override of `import_duplicate_match_key` that spelled `{{field}}` printed the placeholder literally and now prints the API names. That is the documented meaning of the placeholder (module docblock, Interpolation), and the changeset says it for all three sentences.
- **Row text.** The English `import_multi_value_match_key` sentence changed again (two sentences joined, final stop dropped). It reaches only the pulls' failed rows; `code`, `field`, `action` and row shape are as at the prior head. Human text, not contract.

### ② Semver level

- `@objectstack/spec` patch, `@objectstack/core` patch: unchanged and still correct. No other released package is in the diff against `main`.
- No BREAKING banner is owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Check-runs on this head: 74, of which 62 success and 12 skipped, none failed or pending. `Test Core` 10/10 shards and aggregate, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Check Changeset`, `PR-body guards` and `Spec property liveness` are success.
- `export.mdx` is regenerated, not hand-edited: both `matchFields` rows carry the new describe sentence verbatim (2 occurrences), and the docs gate is green on the head.
- Landing distance: `origin/main` is 15 first-parent commits past the merge base, none touching the eight files of this PR.
- The dev's ablation counts (blank-key site 3 of 9 red, multi-value site 5 of 32 red) are the zone's readings, taken as reported; nothing was run here.
- `security_findings: withheld`: asked of the zone privately by the seat; nothing on the thread to answer. Read independently on the delta: no read, write or permission path is added; `field` is interpolated as a value in the same single pass as `label`, so an API name or label spelling a placeholder prints as written.

### ④ Design judgment

S1, each claim held against the code at this head:

- **Locale given, that language; else English.** `coerceCtx.locale` is `context?.locale` (`import-runner.ts` ~1066) and all three helpers pass it; `renderValidationMessage` defaults an absent locale to `en` and falls back to the `en` entry.
- **Override only where the caller passes a translator.** The override lookup sits inside `if (opts.translate)`; `translate` is `opts.translate` of `runImport`, nothing else supplies one.
